prompts.vr: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent reusable game-map level platform sprite for an existing Chinese student learning website. ORIGINAL truly COARSE PIXEL ART, obvious large square pixels and staircase silhouettes, like a carefully hand-drawn 64x64 pixel game sprite enlarged by nearest neighbor. Simple shapes, thick 2-pixel logical dark navy outline, flat 2-tone shading only, navy/cream/cyan with small amber accents. Isometric 3/4 view, single floating octagonal platform, upper-left light, consistent platform scale. Entire silhouette in square frame with transparent padding. Foreground lower center is a clear empty small landing pad where a separately rendered astronaut will stand; no people or astronauts embedded. NO typography, words, labels, numbers, logos, watermark, starfield, UI or background; genuine transparent alpha. NO smooth gradient, antialiasing, 3D rendering, painterly texture, miniature intricate details, soft lighting, blur or thin continuous lines. Bold simplified low-resolution pixels must remain obvious at 192px website size. Subject: a VISITABLE VR LABORATORY facility. One very recognizable oversized VR headset with two cyan rectangular eye lenses above a small open experience booth, a simple virtual-space projection device and control plinth on the back half of the platform. A few large chunky geometric blocks suggest immersive equipment. The large headset silhouette must clearly distinguish this from generic space stations. Keep the empty landing pad in front unobstructed.
